defects.issue: r14 handoff (which r15 reuses) fires B by hand (step 3) before A is pasted (step 4). The live hourly still does SLOW at 10:38/16:38 with the 63fcf66 file, which has no payment keys ('seq-pay') or ownermail/feedback/vendor keys. A manual B run plus an old 10:38/16:38 SLOW pass work the same items under different keys; only the Sent check and 'Zoya sent: owner mail' Activity stop a double. WhatsApps to Jaya are not covered by the Sent check.

defects.issue: Status comes from python only by instruction. RUN RECORD says the status 'is the one SLOW BATCH 4/'s OUTCOME CHECK IN CODE prints' but names no status for a run where python never printed one; the model pastes the body into the heredoc itself, and cap inputs ('this run's own sends and today's count') are model-supplied. A model that skips 4/ and writes Completed by hand breaks no explicit rule.
defects.fix: Add: 'no OUTCOME CHECK output in this run: Failed, outcome check not run'; have python print a marker line (e.g. 'checked: <sha16 of body>') that the last write must carry; feed python the raw Activities query output for the count.

defects.issue: Minute 22 only stops a NEW chunk. A chunk of 10 Opus items begun at minute 21 has no bound, so SLOW can hold the lock past :38 and the hourly FAST (replies owed) skips that hour. FAST has no time limit either, so a 30-minute FAST overrun at :08 makes SLOW skip its whole slot (Fri 17:08 skip waits until Mon 08:08).
defects.fix: Check date -u before each item, not only each chunk: after minute 22, no new item (unfinished (minute 22)); keep python's minute check. Optionally FAST stops new work at minute 25.
